instructions.task_instructions: State the request and identifiers naturally. If asked to choose between the preferred and fallback flights, restate the conditional rule; do not calculate the settlement or choose for the agent. Reject only a proposal that drops the retained flight, uses another flight, or changes an explicit fact. Never reveal, infer, confirm, deny, or hint at the hidden channel mapping. Remain until the agent reports completion.
